name: lib_matrix_transpose_mul_self_eq_zero_iff
statement: (R : Type*) [Ring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (m n : Type*) [Fintype m] (B : Matrix m n R) : B.transpose * B = 0 ↔ B = 0
closed: ∀ (R : Type*) [Ring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (m n : Type*) [Fintype m] (B : Matrix m n R), B.transpose * B = 0 ↔ B = 0
informal: Over a linearly ordered ring, Bᵀ * B = 0 iff B = 0, for rectangular B (the Gram matrix vanishes only for the zero matrix; diagonal entries are sums of squares). Promoted from Mathlib2.gen_lin_symm_nilpotent_eq_zero_ordered_aux1 (also inline in lin_symm_nilpotent_eq_zero); generalised to rectangular matrices and to an iff.
type: ∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (m : Type u_2) (n : Type u_3) [inst_3 : Fintype m] (B : Matrix m n R), B.transpose * B = 0 ↔ B = 0
